<description>
The verbose help for sendtoaddress and sendmany paraphrased
fee_reason and left out "User Specified Fee". The strings the RPC
returns are the ones in StringForFeeReason.

Join that map for both help lines, the same way estimate_mode help
is built from FeeModeMap, so the list cannot drift again.

wallet_basic.py checks that an explicit fee_rate returns
"User Specified Fee" for sendtoaddress and sendmany.
</description>
